en.Физика с нуля: всё для коллоквиума по ли: Physics from scratch: everything for the colloquium on worksheets 1 and 2.
en.Путь от нуля: математика-минимум, единиц: A path from zero: minimum maths, units, vectors, kinematics, projectile motion, forces, friction, inclined plane, pulleys. For each topic — formulas, how to choose them, and a worked example with numbers.

en.Читай по порядку и после каждой карточки: Read in order, and after each card solve the example by hand without peeking. The numbers in the examples were checked by calculation; g = 10 m/s².
en.Как решать любую задачу по физике: How to solve any physics problem
en.Нарисуй ситуацию и обозначь известное бу: Draw the situation and label the known quantities with letters.
en.Переведи в СИ: метры, секунды, килограмм: Convert to SI: metres, seconds, kilograms (km/h → m/s, cm → m, g → kg).
en.Выбери формулу по тому, что дано и что н: Choose a formula based on what is given and what must be found (tables below).

en.Проверь: единицы получились верными? отв: Check: did the units come out right? Is the answer plausible (a car's speed is not 5000 m/s)?
en.На коллоквиуме балл дают за ход решения,: At the colloquium, points are given for the working, not only for the answer: write the formula, the substitution, and the answer with units. Take g = 10 m/s² unless stated otherwise (the worksheets do).
en.Решение уравнения: что делаешь слева, де: Solving an equation: whatever you do on the left, do on the right. From v = at we get t = v/a; from s = ½at² we get t = √(2s/a).
en.Синус, косинус, тангенс в прямоугольном: Sine, cosine, tangent in a right triangle: sin α = opposite leg / hypotenuse; cos α = adjacent leg / hypotenuse; tan α = opposite / adjacent.
en.Калькулятор должен стоять в режиме граду: The calculator must be in degree (DEG) mode, not radians.
en.Км/ч → м/с: делим на 3,6. М/с → км/ч: ум: km/h → m/s: divide by 3.6. m/s → km/h: multiply by 3.6. Time: 1 h = 3600 s, 1 min = 60 s.
en.Вектор — величина с числом и направление: A vector is a quantity with a magnitude and a direction (velocity, force, displacement). In coordinates: a = (aₓ, a_y).
en.Вектор AB = (координаты конца B) − (коор: Vector AB = (coordinates of the end B) − (coordinates of the start A).
en.Скалярное произведение — число (не векто: The dot product is a number (not a vector). If it is 0, the vectors are perpendicular.
en.Равномерное (скорость постоянна): s = vt: Uniform (constant velocity): s = vt. Uniformly accelerated (constant acceleration a):
en.Старт с места: v₀ = 0. Торможение: a отр: Starting from rest: v₀ = 0. Braking: a is negative (directed against the velocity). Coming to a complete stop: v = 0.
en.Задача про поезд: разбей на участки (раз: Train problem: split it into stages (acceleration, uniform motion, braking) and compute each separately: the speed at the end of acceleration is the speed of the uniform stage. Total distance = sum of the distances.
en.Разгон. Автомобиль с места, a = 2 м/с²,:
Acceleration. A car starts from rest, a = 2 m/s², t = 5 s: v = 2·5 = 10 m/s, s = ½·2·25 = 25 m.
Braking. v₀ = 20 m/s, a = −4 m/s² until stopping: t = (0 − 20)/(−4) = 5 s; from v² = v₀² + 2as: 0 = 400 − 8s, s = 50 m.
en.Тела едут навстречу: скорости сближения: Bodies moving towards each other: closing speeds add up, v = v₁ + v₂.
en.Едут в одну сторону, второй догоняет: v: Moving in the same direction, the second catches up: v = v₂ − v₁ (faster minus slower).
en.Время встречи/обгона: t = расстояние / с: Time to meeting/overtaking: t = distance / closing speed.
en.Пример. Два автомобиля навстречу, 20 и 3:
Example. Two cars towards each other, 20 and 30 m/s, distance 1000 m: closing speed 50 m/s, t = 1000/50 = 20 s.
Same direction: front car 20 m/s, rear car 30 m/s, 100 m between them: closing speed 10 m/s, t = 100/10 = 10 s.
en.Движение по горизонтали и по вертикали с: Treat horizontal and vertical motion separately: along x — uniform (a = 0), along y — uniformly accelerated with a = −g (downwards).
en.Горизонтальный бросок со стола высотой h: Horizontal launch from a table of height h
en.Пример. Шарик слетает со стола h = 1,8 м: Example. A ball rolls off a table h = 1.8 m high and lands 2.1 m away. t = √(2·1.8/10) = 0.6 s. v₀ = 2.1/0.6 = 3.5 m/s. v_y = 10·0.6 = 6 m/s; impact speed v = √(3.5² + 6²) = √48.25 ≈ 6.95 m/s.
en.Бросок под углом α к горизонту: Launch at angle α to the horizontal
en.Пример. v₀ = 20 м/с, α = 30°: T = 2·20·0:
Example. v₀ = 20 m/s, α = 30°: T = 2·20·0.5/10 = 2 s; H = 400·0.25/20 = 5 m; R = 400·sin 60°/10 = 400·0.866/10 ≈ 34.6 m.
The range is greatest at 45°. On the Moon g is smaller (1.6 m/s²), so the same throw travels farther: R ∝ 1/g.
en.Для планет (Земля 10, Марс ≈ 3,7, Луна ≈: For planets (Earth 10, Mars ≈ 3.7, Moon ≈ 1.6 m/s²) the formulas are the same; only g changes.
en.Без равнодействующей силы тело покоится: With no net force, a body stays at rest or moves uniformly.
en.F = ma — равнодействующая сила равна мас: F = ma — the net force equals mass times acceleration.
en.Силы действия и противодействия равны и: Action and reaction forces are equal and opposite.
en.из равновесия по оси ⟂ поверхности: from equilibrium along the axis ⟂ to the surface
en.вдоль нити, от тела: along the string, away from the body
Draw the body and all forces acting on it.
en.Выбери оси: одна вдоль ускорения, другая: Choose axes: one along the acceleration, the other perpendicular.
en.Для каждой оси запиши: сумма сил по оси: For each axis write: sum of forces along the axis = ma (along an axis with no acceleration — 0).
Find N, then F<sub>f</sub> = μN, then a.
en.Трение: брусок на горизонтальной поверхн: Friction: a block on a horizontal surface
en.Вертикаль: N = mg (если сила вдоль повер: Vertical: N = mg (if the force acts along the surface). Horizontal: ma = F − μN.
en.Пример. m = 5 кг, μ = 0,2, тянем силой F:
Example. m = 5 kg, μ = 0.2, pulled with force F = 20 N. N = 5·10 = 50 N; Ff = 0.2·50 = 10 N; a = (20 − 10)/5 = 2 m/s².
If the force is directed upwards at an angle α, it partly unloads the surface: N = mg − F sin α, and F cos α acts along the motion: a = (F cos α − μN)/m.
en.Если F ≤ μmg, брусок не сдвинется (трени: If F ≤ μmg, the block will not move (static friction balances the force): a = 0.
en.Ось вдоль плоскости и ось перпендикулярн: One axis along the plane and one perpendicular to it. Gravity is resolved: along the slope — mg sin α (pulls down the slope), across it — mg cos α (presses into the surface).
en.Пример. α = 30°, μ = 0,2: a = 10·(0,5 −:
Example. α = 30°, μ = 0.2: a = 10·(0.5 − 0.2·0.866) = 10·0.3268 ≈ 3.27 m/s² down the slope.
It slides only if sin α > μ cos α, i.e. tan α > μ. If it is pulled up the plane, friction points down the slope, and μmg cos α is added to mg sin α.
en.Нерастяжимая нить: связанные тела имеют: Inextensible string: connected bodies have accelerations of equal magnitude.
en.Для каждого тела — свой второй закон, по: Write Newton's second law for each body separately, then solve the system.
en.Идеальный блок и невесомая нить: натяжен: Ideal pulley and massless string: the tension is the same on both sides.
en.Брусок m₁ на столе (без трения) и груз m: Block m₁ on a frictionless table and weight m₂ hanging on a string over a pulley:
en.Пример. m₁ = 2 кг, m₂ = 3 кг: a = 3·10/5:
Example. m₁ = 2 kg, m₂ = 3 kg: a = 3·10/5 = 6 m/s², T = 2·6 = 12 N (check: m₂g − T = 30 − 12 = 18 = m₂a = 3·6 ✓).
With friction on the table: add −μm₁g to the block's equation, a = (m₂g − μm₁g)/(m₁+m₂).
en.Два бруска на нити, тянем силой F: снача: Two blocks on a string, pulled with force F: first treat the whole system, a = (F − total friction)/(m₁+m₂), then find the tension from the equation for one body.

en.Типичные ошибки: забыл перевести км/ч в: Typical mistakes: forgetting to convert km/h to m/s; using sin instead of cos; forgetting that a < 0 when braking; taking N = mg on an inclined plane (there N = mg cos α); calculator in radians.
